schema: roadmap section 14.1 (T22); 'manifest' is a T22 addition

meta.retrieved_at_basis: retrieved_at is the earliest file modification time in the manifest scan, not a recorded download time
meta.license_policy: Every entry is unverified/not_permitted until a person records terms_url, terms_retrieved_at and terms_sha256 (A-4). No tool sets 'verified'.
meta.excluded: Frontier / HPC data has no entry by design; scripts/check_register.py fails if code references it.

datasets.permitted_use: Local development and offline evaluation by the code paths in used_by only. No redistribution. Terms unverified: a person must record evidence (A-4) before any wider use.

Use as the source of the carbon (gamma) term: src/carbon_provider.py reads data/cleaned/carbon_intensity.csv, a file no code in this repository produces

datasets.source_name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0 water risk data (baseline, future; annual and monthly)
datasets.version_or_date: Aqueduct 4.0, download Y2023M07D05 (taken from the folder name)
datasets.spatial_resolution: Hydrological sub-basin polygons (string_id, pfaf_id, aqid); aggregated by country in src/data_generator.py
datasets.temporal_resolution: Annual baseline (file Aqueduct40_baseline_annual_y2023m07d05.csv); monthly and future tables are present but unread
preprocessing: src/ingestion/water_stress_aqueduct.py selects columns, replaces sentinel values -9999.0 and 9999.0, checks scores in [0, 5], writes data/cleaned/water_stress_aqueduct.csv
src/data_generator.py min-max normalises bws_score across the table
datasets.permitted_use: Local development and offline evaluation by the code paths in used_by only. No redistribution. Terms unverified: a person must record evidence (A-4) before any wider use.
supported_claims: Only the baseline annual table is read. src/data_generator.py uses one static, min-max-normalised bws_score per country as the water-stress baseline of generated data, combined with a synthetic seasonal and drought overlay, when data/cleaned/water_stress_aqueduct.csv exists
prohibited_claims: A water-stress input that drives cooling-mode arbitration or supports patent Claim 8: the drought override acts on whatever water_stress value it is given, and Aqueduct supplies only a static country baseline
Facility-level or basin-level water risk for a site
Monthly, future or projected water risk (those tables are not read)
Any licence, reuse or redistribution statement: no terms evidence is recorded (license_status is unverified) (the earlier manifest wording 'open data' is an unverified claim)
